name: Shadcn Packaged
summary: npm package that exports all shadcn/ui components, hooks and utils with TypeScript declarations, no CLI needed.
description: An npm package that packages the shadcn/ui component files as ordinary imports instead of copy-paste, so no CLI or file copying is needed. It ships components under shadcn-packaged/ui, hooks under shadcn-packaged/hooks and utils under shadcn-packaged/lib/utils, with type declarations and IDE auto-import support, and publishes the latest components to npm weekly. Works with React projects on Tailwind CSS v4 (Next.js and Vite configuration documented).
contains: all shadcn/ui components as npm exports, no CLI or copy-paste
package structure: ui components, hooks, lib utils
type declarations and IDE auto-import support
weekly npm publishes of the latest components
Tailwind CSS v4 support; Next.js and Vite config documented
